subject: cloak
notes_en: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

subject: consecrated_wraps
description_en: Passive: Hallowed  Gain a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s, up to a maximum of %AbilityCharges% charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by %movement_speed_pct_on_stack_gain%%% for %duration%s.  Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan, consume all charges to gain an all damage barrier for %duration%s that absorbs %barrier_per_stack% damage per charge (%max_barrier_tooltip% max).
notes_en: Charges cannot be gained for %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s after you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan.
Self-damage and HP Loss damage cannot remove charges.
Movement speed buff does not stack.

subject: crellas_crozier
description_en: Active: Rite of Rumusque  You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.  Steal %movespeed_steal_pct%%% movement speed from enemy heroes in %active_radius% range every second. Movement speed steal lasts %stack_duration%s.  Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to %active_health_steal%%%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.   Passive: Putrefaction Aura Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by %health_steal%%%.  Radius: %radius%
notes_en: Ghost form ends if you become Debuff Immune and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Putrefaction Aura does not redirect Health Restoration from enemy heroes that are at full health.

subject: crimson_guard
description_en: Active: Guard  For %duration% seconds, grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a %block_chance_active%%% chance to block damage equal to %block_damage_active% plus %max_hp_pct%%% of the caster's max health value from each incoming attack.  Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%   Passive: Damage Block  Grants a %block_chance%%% chance to block %block_damage_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %block_damage_ranged% damage on ranged.
notes_en: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
When the Guard buff is applied to ranged heroes, Guard blocks %block_penalty_ranged% less damage.
Guard does not affect units that have been affected by Guard within Crimson Guard's cooldown.

subject: cyclone
description_en: Active: Cyclone  Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.  Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: You cannot cyclone allies.
Cyclones cast on yourself go through spell immunity.
Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.

subject: dagon
description_en: Active: Energy Burst  Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.  Damage: %damage%  Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes_en: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

subject: desolator
description_en: Passive: Corruption  Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.   Passive: Soul Stealer  Desolator gains +%bonus_damage_per_kill% damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of %max_damage%.
notes_en: Armor reduction works on buildings.

subject: devastator
description_en: Passive: Witch Blade  Causes your next attack to have true strike, apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds, slowing by %slow%%% and dealing %int_damage_multiplier%x your intelligence as damage every second.   Passive: Magic Corruption  Your attacks reduce the enemy's Magic resistance by %active_mres_reduction%%% for %passive_cooldown% seconds.

subject: diffusal_blade
description_en: Active: Inhibit  Targets an enemy, slowing it for %purge_slow_duration% seconds.   Passive: Manabreak Each attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.   Illusions do not burn mana.
notes_en: Does not stack with other diffusal blades.

subject: disperser
description_en: Active: Suppress  Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for %enemy_effect_duration% seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and %slow_resist%%% slow resistance for %ally_effect_duration% seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.  Both movement speed reduction and increase start at %phase_movement_speed%%% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel    Passive: Manabreak Each attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.   Illusions do not burn mana.

subject: dragon_lance
notes_en: Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

subject: dust
description_en: Use: Reveal For %duration% seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by %movespeed%%% in a %radius% radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take %damage% damage.   The debuff effect on enemies lingers for %linger_duration%s after leaving the area of effect.
notes_en: Places a debuff on enemy units in the area that reveals them when they are invisible.

subject: echo_sabre
description_en: Passive: Echo Strike  Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike.

subject: eldwurms_edda
description_en: Passive: Forbidden Knowledge When consumed, increases Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by %intellect_pct%%% of its current value at the time of consumption, and increases the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one. All values except for Mana Cost scale by 50% of the difference between their existing levels for the additional level

subject: enchanted_mango
description_en: Use: Eat Mango  Instantly restores %replenish_amount% mana.
notes_en: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

subject: essence_distiller
description_en: Active: Soul Release  Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies.  Can be ground targeted to lie dormant for up to %ground_duration%s and attach to the first enemy that comes within %latch_range% radius. When on enemies, deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second and provides True Sight over them and shares their vision with the wearer's team.  Lasts %duration% seconds.  Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.
notes_en: Empty distillers gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Essence Distiller to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
While dormant, provides vision in %latch_vision% radius. Vision lingers for %linger_after_latch_duration%s after latching.
